residual_findings.title: React Router: open redirect via backslash in <Link> and useNavigate (CVE-2025-68470 bypass)
residual_findings.reason: Requires an attacker-controlled string with a leading backslash to reach a <Link to> or navigate() target. Every dynamic target in frontend/src is either a path this application wrote into history state (checked for the /account/ prefix before use), a value from a fixed set returned by destinationForSession(), or a report/dashboard link built server-side in report_service.py as a literal '/...' path with enum values in the query string. No URL query parameter, form field or API string is ever passed to a navigation.

residual_findings.title: React Router: arbitrary constructor injection via deserializeErrors() in SSR hydration
residual_findings.reason: Requires server-side rendering with a data router and hydrateRoot. main.jsx uses createRoot; there is no StaticRouter, createBrowserRouter, RouterProvider or hydrateRoot anywhere in frontend/src.

OD-37 - no approved terms or privacy text exists. Both versions are placeholders that name themselves as placeholders, and production registration refuses while either is one.

OD-19 - no accessibility reviewer is assigned. 125 automated audits are not a human review.
OD-01 / OD-36 - retention periods are undecided, so no canonical deletion schedule exists.
DEC-0006 - rate limiting is in-process and per-worker. More than one worker needs a shared store.
OD-17 - staff MFA is undecided. OD-33 defers customer MFA separately.
Secrets are not in a secret store; credential_ref must name an entry, never a value.
Provider integration remains deferred (DEC-0075). No adapter, no allowlisted host, no webhook.

known_risks_at_freeze: Accessibility counts are not re-measured for RC-UAT-17 (null in test_counts).
Two backend tests need the main checkout's gitignored databases and fail in a worktree; to be confirmed green there before merge.

The base seed is not fully deterministic: a label print job's shipment ID differs between resets (pre-existing; the air dataset's names, references and amounts are fixed, its dates follow the day of the reset).
The closed month is the last month past M+7 on the day of the reset; dates in the air dataset move with each reset.
Demo exchange readings count as live for a day; a session on a later day needs uat_env.py --refresh-fx.
No vendor mailbox is connected and the FX worker must not be run in UAT (it calls the bank).
The Vietnamese customer wording, the standard update sentences and the vendor surcharge names on customer documents await the owner (19_OWNER_QUESTIONS.md questions 5 to 7).
openpyxl 3.1.5 and et_xmlfile 2.0.0 are new since RC-UAT-16 and not audited by a tool.

Review: the UAT database stored the production intake mailbox and, in the first-save audit, the default approver. The seed sets a test mailbox; the audit records 'owner default'.
